title: SpacetimeDB: a short technical review
summary: A technical review of SpacetimeDB, examining its architecture as a temporal database combined with distributed computing capabilities for building real-time collaborative applications with built-in time-travel query features.
problem_solved: Simplifies building real-time collaborative applications by providing native time-travel queries and automatic state synchronization across distributed nodes.
why_valuable: Reduces application complexity by embedding temporal versioning and distributed consensus directly into the database layer, enabling developers to query historical states effortlessly.
